lines.en: I waddle along the bank.
My green head shines in the sun.
I rock with every step, and I am not quick.
I walk over the marsh grass.
I follow the swamp's waterline.
I flap my wings and take a few steps.

lines.zh: 我的脚蹼在泥上留下纹。
lines.en: My webbed feet print the mud.
I come up from the water, dripping.
I walk half around the pond.
I watch the ground and go slowly.
I quack as I walk.
I squeeze between two clumps of reeds.
I make for the shallows.
I leave a line of little prints.
I stop to tidy my feathers.

lines.zh: 绿头鸭踩着水草，走到浅滩。
lines.en: The mallard walks the waterweed to the shallows.
I float on the water, rocking gently.
Head tucked into my wings.
I preen my breast with my bill.

lines.zh: 水从我的尾羽上滑下去。
lines.en: Water slides off my tail feathers.
I doze in the reeds' shadow.

lines.zh: 单脚站在泥里，我理尾羽。
lines.en: Standing one-legged in mud, I preen my tail.
Rings spread across the pond.
I shake and water flies.
I turn about on the water.

lines.zh: 沼泽里有很多虫子在飞。
lines.en: There are many insects over the marsh.

lines.zh: 芦苇那边有虫，我够不着。
lines.en: Insects beyond the reeds; I can't reach them.
Water beads sit on my feathers.
I quack once. Nothing answers.

lines.zh: 我把头扎进水里，屁股朝上。
lines.en: I dip my head under, tail up.
You are at the edge of my pond.
I am not that small. Do not step on me.
Do you have seaweed in your hand?

lines.zh: 狐狸来的时候你也这样站着吗？
lines.en: Do you stand like that when the fox comes?

lines.zh: 我认得这片沼泽的每一处。
lines.en: I know every corner of this marsh.
To catch me you would have to enter the water.
My eggs are in the reeds.
One step back and I will not be afraid.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你手里的海草。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the seaweed in your hand.
You do not smell of seaweed.
I quack and run.
A few down feathers came loose.
I head for the water at an angle.
I flap and cannot steady myself.
I hide deep in the reeds.
A small drop of blood is by the water.
Two urgent quacks, and I dive into the reeds.
I press my wings tight to my body.

lines.zh: 翅膀挨了一下，我还能划水。
lines.en: One wing took a hit; I can still paddle.
I make slowly for the far bank.
Seaweed? I know that smell.

lines.zh: 海草落水，我摇着屁股过去。
lines.en: The seaweed drops; I waddle over.
I waddle over.
That mouthful vanished quickly.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面，我下的是能染色的蛋。
lines.en: On the marsh, I lay dyeable eggs.
I will preen after eating.
Not enough. Bring more.
There is plenty more to eat in the water.
Step back; I am going into the water.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水草，比面包好吃。
lines.en: Swamp weed beats bread.
You crowded me.

lines.zh: 被撞得偏了半尺，我又摆正。
lines.en: Knocked half a foot off course, I right myself.
A patch of feathers is bent.
I waddle aside a little.

lines.zh: 羽毛厚，撞一下只掉了点水。
lines.en: Thick feathers; the bump only shakes off water.
My webbed foot slipped.
Water splashes over both of us.

lines.zh: 我低头钻过，翅膀擦你膝盖。
lines.en: I duck through, wing brushing your knee.
You are clumsier on the bank than I am.
I quack and head for the water.
We float side by side on the water.
There is room for a nest in the reeds.
I swim after you and do not fall behind.
I quack twice, and you quack twice.

lines.zh: 这片水塘够我们过日子。
lines.en: This pond is enough for the two of us.

lines.zh: 我用喙碰你的颈侧，很轻。
lines.en: I touch your neck with my bill, gently.
You watch the reeds; I watch the water.
If the fox comes, wake me.

lines.zh: 我的蛋会是很漂亮的颜色。
lines.en: My eggs will be a lovely color.
Same pond tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我脖子上那圈绿，是沼泽给的。
lines.en: The green ring on my neck came from the swamp.
Held in the water, it feels weightless.
I shake it and the water flies off.

lines.zh: 小螺一口吞下，壳还硌嘴。
lines.en: I swallow a snail whole; the shell scrapes.
It drifted away in the water.

lines.zh: 一口下去不对味，我吐了。
lines.en: One bite tasted wrong. I spat it out.

lines.zh: 我用喙推着它，滚上泥坡。
lines.en: I push it with my bill, rolling it up the bank.
My bill is too flat to grip it.
I carry it a few steps.
It is stuck to my feathers.
Something moved at the water's edge.
I swim slowly over to look.
I have grown wary.
I know the smell of a fox.
I move deeper into the reeds.

lines.zh: 你站在我的入水口上，让让。
lines.en: You're blocking my way into the water; move.
A flap of my wings and I am up.
I quack twice, loudly.
In the water I am safe.
I do not start trouble with anyone.

lines.zh: 你的靴子一动，我就数一步。
lines.en: Each boot shift, I count a step.
You step forward, and I step back.

lines.zh: 我把绿头压低，盯着你手。
lines.en: I lower my green head, watching your hands.
The water is right behind me.
The reeds can hide my body.

lines.zh: 脚蹼贴着泥，我横着挪开。
lines.en: Webbed feet on mud, I sidestep away.
I count the steps remaining.

lines.zh: 你身上没有水草的诚意。
lines.en: You have brought no seaweed to show good faith.
My wings are half raised.
Any closer and I take to the water.
I lunge and peck once.
My wing beats your hand.
That sent me stumbling back too.
I quack and run backwards.
My flat bill knocks your ankle.
I splash water high.
I dive into the reeds.
My bill catches your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 扁嘴拧住你的指节，松不松？
lines.en: My flat bill twists your knuckle—letting go?
I dive headfirst into the water.
I waddle out of the reeds.
There is one more duck on the pond.
I went into the water first.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水刚好没到我的肚子。
lines.en: The swamp water comes to my belly.
My green head shows even in the shade.
I shake the water off and my feathers puff up.
There are plenty of insects in this marsh.
I float over to the edge of the reeds.

lines.zh: 我嘎了一声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I quack once by way of greeting.

lines.zh: 我从苇丛钻出，水面起圈。
lines.en: I push out of the reeds; rings spread on the water.
The edge of my feathers is scorched. I fear fire.

lines.zh: 我从半空摔下来，落地很重。
lines.en: I fall from the air and land heavily.
The water is too deep; my feet find no bottom.

lines.zh: 我的绿头羽湿透了，飞不起来。
lines.en: My green head feathers are soaked; I cannot fly.
There is a hole in my wing now.

lines.zh: 一股冷意让我张不开翅。
lines.en: A cold force keeps my wings shut.

lines.zh: 水塘里没什么可吃的了。
lines.en: There is little left to eat in the pond.
The thunder frightens me into the reeds.
I fall and cannot find the water.
